notes.title: Rogue Party 2 Scheduled Release: June 15, 2020
notes.content:
Many of you know this already, but I lost the code for the original Rogue Party. I was devastated and took a break from making games.

But didn't last long, and I ended up using Unity this time around to make a much better sequel.

Thank you for buying my games and supporting an independent developer!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1274980/Rogue_Party_2/

notes.title: New Legionnaire Enemy!
notes.content:
Introducing the Legionnaire, an enraged spirit haunting the armor it wore while alive!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33422551/bfac7357b25e3b53eff0ac4671ba77de58021794.png[/img]

This new threat will appear in the levels leading up to the Wizard and provide a serious challenge when combined with enemies like the abominable.

Being a melee fighter, the Legionnaire relies on his ability to cast a shield around himself which deflects all ranged damaged (potions and effects will still get through) in order to close the gap. Shooting the shield will not hurt the Legionnaire directly, so this is the best time to run away instead of engaging them.

Their shield can be a real problem when encountering multiple enemies as it will protect anything behind them as well as themselves.

If the Legionnaire manages to catch up to you he will wind up and swing his swords in a straight line. It is possible to avoid this with a well timed side step.

The legionnaire is considered a rare spawn enemy (1-10%) along with the Lizard-kin, Exploding Golem and Demon Body.

(Note: If you have three undying items it's the same as having 3 extra lives!)

notes.title: "Shocking" Patch 1/11/2019

A "Shocking" new prefix has been added to the game. It has a 33% chance to fire off a bolt of lightning when striking enemies. High damage but random patterns of attack.

-= New Item =-
Chaotic Bolts can now be unlocked for 20 repetetive boss kills. 8 second cooldown to fire two bolts of lightning that move in a consistent pattern.

-= FOV Option Added =-
You can now set the field of view (degrees) your character can see around them, from 45 default to 120.

-= Nerfed Proc'ing Prefixes =-
Prefixes that spawn bullets such as Shocking, Pyro and Homing no longer can proc off themselves. Sorry this was just way too OP, especially with Pyro.

notes.title: Christmas Miracle! I fixed the big bad bug!
notes.content:
As many of you know there was one major bug in the game that has eluded me since release.

I believe I've finally squashed it and you should always have bosses spawning at the end of each 5 level zone.

Based on what I learned fixing the bug it was a rounding issue that left less than a 1% chance of the boss not spawning. It should be fixed now, but let me know if it ever happens again for you.

Thanks everyone! While I am busy working on blocked and loaded 2 don't worry I will eventualy go back and add more stuff to Rogue Party. It was designed to allow easy additions without having to create all new levels.

Shout out to Coolguy1079 who is likely the only person who has beaten the boss. Even I haven't yet!

notes.title: Expansion? Help me design it!
notes.content:
===Final Boss===

I'm not ready quite yet to nerf th boss. Just because I'm struggling to beat him doesn't mean it's impossible.... but man do I wish I could get my hands on that epic loot!

Please help me beat it on discord: https://discord.gg/NThERTU

===Bug Report===

There is a bug with volatile infection that doesn't break the game but causes it to appear on enemies at the start of a new level. It happens to guests only and is graphical in nature. Having a hard time fixing it without increasing network packets between players.

===Expansion===

My first thought for an expansion was to add 5 more levels and a boss, but I think the game is already quite long for a single playthrough.

What do you think about adding enemies, potions, bosses, and new unlockable weapons/items to the current maps/levels?

Let me know your ideas in the forums!

Thanks,

Chris
